## Engineering Philosophy & System Architecture
IBRA Digital Engineering builds modern software rooted in first principles, mathematical efficiency, and strict modularity.
- Zero Technical Debt: Strict adherence to clean architecture, single responsibility, and maximum component size constraints (files <= 150 lines).
- Modern Frontend Standards: Next.js App Router with Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Server Components, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and zero-compromise responsive design adhering to Apple Human Interface Guidelines.
- Cloud & Data Persistence: Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS), real-time event subscriptions, and edge compute functions.
- Performance Targets: 100/100 Core Web Vitals, sub-second LCP, zero CLS, and low bundle footprints.
- CDN & Security Layer: Cloudflare DNS routing, TLS 1.3, strict security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy).

## Service Offerings & Scope

### 1. Landing Page Development
- Target Audience: Local enterprises, service providers, event organizers, personal brands.
- Turnaround Time: 3 to 5 business days.
- Core Features: Next.js SSR, responsive layout, WhatsApp direct CTA, Google Tag Manager & Meta Pixel integration, local SEO metadata.
- Starting Investment: Rp 1.500.000.

### 2. Official Institutional & School Web Portals
- Target Audience: Schools (SD, SMP, SMA, SMK), higher education departments, government offices, foundational NGOs.
- Core Features: Accreditation showcase, faculty directories, academic calendars, news announcements, responsive photo galleries, Google Maps schema integration.
- Starting Investment: Rp 3.500.000.

### 3. Custom Web Applications & LMS Platforms
- Target Audience: Businesses requiring custom workflow automation, schools requiring attendance and grading systems, landlords requiring tenancy tracking.
- Core Features: Supabase authentication, RBAC (Role-Based Access Control), GPS geofence validation, WhatsApp API webhook notifications, payment gateway callbacks.
- Starting Investment: Rp 7.500.000 to Rp 50.000.000.

## Verified Portfolio Case Studies
1. Kos Fitrah (https://kosfitrah.uk)
   - Cloud management system for boarding house operations.
   - Real-time room status, automated billing calculation, WhatsApp payment reminders, and administrative financial dashboard.
2. IBRA Global English (https://www.ibraglobalenglish.uk)
   - Institutional language training platform providing curriculum information, tutor profiles, class schedules, and direct student registration.
3. School Management & Attendance System
   - Geofenced teacher and student attendance with live mobile check-in and automated report card compilation.

  - Markdown Summary: https://ibradigital.id/llms.txt
  - Markdown Full Knowledge: https://ibradigital.id/llms-full.txt
  - Sitemap: https://ibradigital.id/sitemap.xml
- Supported AI Agents: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Amazonbot, Cohere-ai.
- Content Negotiation: Requests specifying `Accept: text/markdown` or querying `.well-known/agents.json` are served structured text for automated retrieval.

## Legal & Contractual Policies
- Developer Retained Rights: Core source code architecture belongs to IBRA Digital Engineering; clients receive a perpetual, non-exclusive deployment license upon full contract settlement unless buyout terms are executed.
- Down Payment: 50 percent non-refundable commitment fee prior to sprint initialization.
- Revisions: Standard packages include up to 2 minor revision cycles within defined sprint scope; additional feature requests require addendum agreements.
- Data Controller Responsibility: Clients act as Data Controllers under Indonesian Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP No. 27/2022).
